title: ORIC: Benchmarking Object Recognition under Contextual Incongruity in Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating object recognition performance drops (misidentifications and hallucinations) by testing models on incongruous object-context pairs where local visual evidence contradicts strong scene-level priors, comparing the results against context-consistent benchmarks.

Tracking the proportion of 'yes' predictions (YP) and analyzing class-wise precision, recall, and F1 scores to determine if models systematically favor affirmative or negative responses when faced with visual uncertainty.
Comparing model recall metrics across specific object scale tiers (small, medium, and large objects) based on bounding box pixel areas to assess performance disparities linked to visual scale.
